mapper.sql: select c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.phone, c.source, c.estate, c.house_type, c.area, c.budget, c.demand, c.intention_level, c.status, c.owner_name, c.designer_id, c.advisor_id, c.dept_id, c.latest_follow_time, c.next_follow_time, c.loss_reason, c.pay_method, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, du.nick_name as designer_name, au.nick_name as advisor_name, cu.nick_name as create_by_name, d.dept_name, (select count(*) from crm_follow_record fr where fr.customer_id = c.customer_id and fr.follow_type = '3') as visit_count from crm_customer c left join sys_user du on du.user_id = c.designer_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id = c.advisor_id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = c.create_by left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id
mapper.select: where c.status in ('1', '2') and ifnull(c.latest_follow_time, c.create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) order by ifnull(c.latest_follow_time, c.create_time)
mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer (customer_name, phone, source, estate, house_type, area, budget, demand, intention_level, status, owner_name, designer_id, advisor_id, dept_id, loss_reason, pay_method, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{customerName}, #{phone}, #{source}, #{estate}, #{houseType}, #{area}, #{budget}, #{demand}, #{intentionLevel}, #{status}, #{ownerName}, #{designerId}, #{advisorId}, #{deptId}, #{lossReason}, #{payMethod}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update crm_customer set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where customer_id = #{customerId}
